race.comment: THE LOUVRE (1) was an emphatic winner last time over 1625m at this track with today's rider Aidan Keeley engaged. Is going well this campaign, recording a win and two minor placings from four starts and should be in the finish. FOUR ACE (3) will find this easier than last start when he raced in a rearwards position and never threatened, finishing tenth over 1350m at Doomben. That effort came on the back of a win two back at this circuit. Better placed this time and can do much better. DATA LEAK (5) did well to score at this venue two runs ago. Not disgraced last time out when in the firing line on the bend before finishing third over 1625m at this course, beaten 2.75 lengths. Best figures measure up and is sure to run well. BURLEIGH MAGIC (7) returned from a spell three-and-a-half weeks ago when he was beaten 6 lengths into sixth over 1200m at Dalby. Fitter now so watch for a better performance.
